# Utana

> Utana Agentic Technologies LLC helps businesses worldwide with AI automation for marketing, sales, and operations. Based in Dubai.

This directory links to public pages. The linked HTML pages are the authoritative service descriptions. Workflow guides describe proposed implementations, not measured customer outcomes.

## Services and company
- [Less busywork More business](https://utana.group/): AI automation for businesses worldwide: marketing, sales, WhatsApp, Meta ads optimisation, agentic discovery, Codex adoption, and business intelligence.
- [sapiens4: agents that work on your computer](https://utana.group/sapiens4.html): sapiens4 is source-available software for macOS and Windows, free for permitted personal and internal business use. Get workflow implementation help from Utana.
- [Agentic discovery for your business](https://utana.group/services/agentic-discovery.html): Agentic discovery services: technical SEO, clear business information, structured data, and useful content for search engines and AI assistants.
- [Agentic workflows and business intelligence](https://utana.group/services/ai-workflows-business-intelligence.html): AI automation and agentic workflows for business intelligence, operational reporting, document processing, and decisions supported by traceable data.
- [Codex for marketing and solopreneurs](https://utana.group/services/codex-for-business.html): Practical Codex adoption for marketing teams and solopreneurs: workflow setup, reporting, research, production support, and reviewable automation.
- [Marketing and sales automation](https://utana.group/services/marketing-sales-automation.html): Marketing automation, sales automation, WhatsApp workflows, and Meta ads optimisation. Connect campaigns to qualified enquiries with Utana.
- [AI automation for the work that matters](https://utana.group/services.html): AI automation services for businesses worldwide: marketing, sales, WhatsApp, agentic discovery, Codex adoption, and business intelligence.
- [Technology chosen around your work](https://utana.group/technology.html): Utana supports Codex, Kimi, DeepSeek, Gemini, OpenClaw, Hermes, grokbot, and Muse workflows. Read our technology approach and model policy.
- [Everyday work Better workflows](https://utana.group/use-cases.html): Practical business automation articles covering sales, operations, clinics, marketing, restaurants, and large organisations.

## Workflow guides and insights
- [Recruiting an AI engineer: from profile to practical evidence](https://utana.group/blog/business-automation.html): A proposed recruiting workflow that gathers project evidence, working demos, and GitHub links for human review.
- [From AI news to ready-to-publish posts](https://utana.group/blog/first-workflow.html): A proposed three-agent workflow to find relevant AI news, draft useful social posts, and prepare branded visuals for human approval.
- [Turning campaign results into better enquiries](https://utana.group/blog/human-judgment.html): A proposed Utana campaign workflow: Meta ads open WhatsApp conversations, while an agent reviews enquiry quality and proposes changes for human approval.
- [Marketing campaign planning and optimisation](https://utana.group/use-cases/campaign-coordination.html): Coordinate research, creative production, launch preparation, and reporting.
- [Clinic appointment and reception administration](https://utana.group/use-cases/clinic-administration.html): Clinic appointment and reception administration: a practical workflow guide covering implementation, human review, and measurement.
- [Clinic administration across the appointment journey](https://utana.group/use-cases/clinic-journey.html): Coordinate administrative tasks before and after an appointment.
- [Reporting across departments and locations](https://utana.group/use-cases/department-reporting.html): Reporting across departments and locations: a practical workflow guide covering implementation, human review, and measurement.
- [Invoice, order, and document processing](https://utana.group/use-cases/document-operations.html): Invoice, order, and document processing: a practical workflow guide covering implementation, human review, and measurement.
- [Employee onboarding and internal service requests](https://utana.group/use-cases/employee-requests.html): Employee onboarding and internal service requests: a practical workflow guide covering implementation, human review, and measurement.
- [From customer enquiry to project delivery](https://utana.group/use-cases/enquiry-to-delivery.html): Connect sales, pricing, onboarding, and operations in one coordinated workflow.
- [Marketing production and campaign reporting](https://utana.group/use-cases/marketing-production.html): Marketing production and campaign reporting: a practical workflow guide covering implementation, human review, and measurement.
- [Procurement and supplier coordination](https://utana.group/use-cases/procurement-coordination.html): Coordinate purchasing requests, supplier quotations, deliveries, and invoice checks.
- [Recruitment intake and interview coordination](https://utana.group/use-cases/recruitment-coordination.html): Organise applications, interview scheduling, feedback, and candidate communication.
- [Operations across multiple restaurant locations](https://utana.group/use-cases/restaurant-locations.html): Bring local reporting, purchasing, and management review into one coordinated process.
- [Restaurant reservations, stock, and supplier coordination](https://utana.group/use-cases/restaurant-operations.html): Restaurant reservations, stock, and supplier coordination: a practical workflow guide covering implementation, human review, and measurement.
- [Sales enquiry qualification and follow up](https://utana.group/use-cases/sales-enquiries.html): Sales enquiry qualification and follow up: a practical workflow guide covering implementation, human review, and measurement.
- [Proposal preparation and sales administration](https://utana.group/use-cases/sales-proposals.html): Proposal preparation and sales administration: a practical workflow guide covering implementation, human review, and measurement.
- [Customer support with investigation and resolution](https://utana.group/use-cases/support-investigation.html): Investigate requests across records and prepare a reviewed resolution.
- [Dubai off-plan property: the daily lowest entry tickets](https://utana.group/use-cases/uae-real-estate.html): Turn scattered inventory updates into a daily shortlist of each developer’s lowest-priced options.
